title: ServiceNow Security Flaws Allow Attackers to Execute SQL and Modify Instance Data
content_md: ServiceNow has disclosed five vulnerabilities affecting its AI Platform, including two critical flaws that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands, extract sensitive instance data, modify records, and escalate privileges.
